name: ecorex-desktop
description: EcoreX desktop shell for the compatible agent runtime
author: EcoreX

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:win: npm run stage:runtime:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:win:signed: npm run sign:win:preflight && npm run stage:runtime:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && npm run sign:win:unpacked && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never && npm run sign:win:setup
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run package:mac:arm64 && npm run package:mac:x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run stage:runtime:mac -- --python-arch x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
